prompt: Challenge C022-CH3: We want to add a water-balance module so farmers can plan irrigation scheduling, but none of our staff understands evapotranspiration modell

content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Summer evapotranspiration has been computed by the Penman–Monteith equation to estimate groundwater recharge in a Vojvodina agricultural catchment, and a daily soil water balance model has been used to assess future recharge across Vojvodina.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03044","field":"abstract","quote":"summer evapotranspiration computed by the Penman–Monteith equation"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-03051","field":"abstract","quote":"a daily soil water balance model driven by statistically downscaled outputs"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"Mean annual recharge across Vojvodina has been estimated at 43 mm/yr depending on soil texture and land use.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03051","field":"abstract","quote":"Baseline mean annual recharge across the study domain was estimated at 43 mm/yr (range 22–68 mm/yr) depending on soil texture and land use"}]},{"claim":3,"text":"Water-table hydrographs were decomposed to separate canal-recharge signals from precipitation-driven responses using a cross-correlation approach during the 2018 and 2019 irrigation seasons.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03049","field":"abstract","quote":"Water-table hydrographs were decomposed to separate canal-recharge signals from precipitation-driven responses using a cross-correlation approach. Canal recharge elevated groundwater levels by up to 0.9 m within 200 m of the canal within 48–72 hours of gate opening, with the response attenuating to below detection threshold at 1.4 km during the 2018 and 2019 irrigation seasons"}]}]}
